text:
maria: quick sync — we need a compact API failure taxonomy before we lock launch criteria for chat, embeddings, and tool calls. main asks: clear client retry guidance, deterministic mapping for transient vs permanent, and per-endpoint nuance. :thinking:

devon: +1. customers keep asking how to treat 429 vs model_busy vs overloaded GPUs. want simple rules we can document in SDKs.

sam: agree. proposal: three buckets — client_validation, rate_control, model_capacity. each gets suggested `retry-after` semantics and an example HTTP status.

anika: sounds good. we should also specify whether we return partial output (structured-output pipelines) on downstream validation errors vs full failure. some customers rely on partials.

maria: important: differentiations per surface. chat/completions may return partial tokens in mid-stream; embeddings should be atomic. function-calls need structured error payloads so clients can decide to retry tool invocation vs fallback.

devon: sketches: 

```
// canonical error types
{
  "type": "client_validation", // bad input, no retry
  "http": 400
}

{
  "type": "rate_control", // burst or steady rate exceeded
  "http": 429, // include `retry_after` in seconds when known
}

{
  "type": "model_capacity", // transient, try fallback or retry
  "http": 503
}
```

sam: also call out `soft_throttle` (202 + partial queue) for Dedicated burst scenarios. and `model_variant_fallback` hint when we auto-route to smaller model.

anika: + note: for embeddings we should never return 202/partial — either succeed or return validation/availability error. reduces client complexity.

maria: negotiation question: are we okay with returning streaming partials + a final `error` frame for chat when model runs OOM vs returning `model_capacity` earlier and no partials? engineering cost tradeoff.

devon: runtime prefers early surface (no partials) for OOM — simpler and consistent. but it loses UX for long generations. maybe make it opt-in via `allow_partial=true`.

sam: that opt-in should be explicit SDK flag. default is no partials for correctness. doc example: `client = Redwood({ allow_partial: false })`

anika: launch gating: we need docs, SDK behavior, and console SLOs. minimum criteria: consistent mapping for the three buckets, sample client retry pseudo-code, and observable metrics emitting `error_type` tag.

maria: + product ask: add a short matrix for customers: "when to retry" with columns: error_type, recommended client action, SLA impact. I'll draft.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: api-errors-reform v0.1 -> staging at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z :rocket:

ops-bot: FYI: infra will surface `gpu_oom` and `queue_depth` metrics; team should map those to `model_capacity` and `soft_throttle` respectively.

devon: one more: include an explicit `client_hint` field in error payloads with values like `no-retry`, `retry-backoff`, `retry-after-seconds`, `fallback-suggested`. avoids HTTP-only ambiguity.

sam: example payload for function-call error: 

```
{
  "error": "tool_timeout",
  "type": "model_capacity",
  "client_hint": "retry-backoff",
  "message": "tool invocation timed out on platform",
  "retry_after": 10
}
```

anika: can we pin a timeframe? product wants this locked by EOW so docs and SDK updates align with the next release.

maria: timeline: agree EOW. action items: 
- dev: final spec for error types and client_hint (devon)
- runtime: decide partials opt-in default (devon + eng-runtime)
- sdk: surface client_hint and `allow_partial` flag (sam)
- docs: matrix + examples (maria)
- observability: emit `error_type` tag and `retry_after` metric (ops)

devon: I'll push a PR with the spec this afternoon.

maria: thanks — once PR is up i'll review and route to legal for API contract language. :eyes:

anika: small clarity: for `rate_control` we should standardize `quota_exceeded` vs `burst_throttle` subtypes so customers can distinguish per-second vs monthly quota.

sam: noted. will add under `rate_control` enum: `["quota_exceeded","burst_throttle","concurrency_limit"]`.

maria: cool. if no objections i'll mark this resolved and track in the launch checklist. :thumbsup:

devon: no objections from eng side.

anika: fine from product.

maria: resolving — will follow up with PR link.
